sql: SELECT 'O' k, market_ticker, side, limit_price::text p, status, coalesce(kalshi_order_id,'-') koid, coalesce(cancel_reason,'') r, created_at::text t FROM live_orders WHERE strategy='Alimm1' AND (status IN ('resting','submitted','pending','unknown') OR created_at > '2026-10-01 09:56') UNION ALL SELECT 'F', market_ticker, side||' '||action, price::text, quantity::text, '', '', filled_at::text FROM fills WHERE filled_at > '2026-10-01 09:56' AND market_ticker IN (SELECT market_ticker FROM live_orders WHERE strategy='Alimm1') ORDER BY 1,8
